$ $**Solution :
$ $**(P) Pyrrole: A 5-membered ring with one nitrogen and 6 π-electrons (lone pair participates). It satisfies Hückel’s (4n + 2) rule → Aromatic (1) and Heterocyclic (5).
$ $**(Q) Protonated Pyrrole: Protonation removes nitrogen’s lone pair from conjugation. The ring loses planarity/conjugation → Non-aromatic (2) but still Heterocyclic (5).
$ $**(R) Cyclopentadienone: Contains 4 π-electrons in a planar conjugated ring. Follows the 4n rule → Antiaromatic (3), thus Unstable (6). Ring has only carbon atoms → Homocyclic (4).
$ $**(S) Tropylium Cation: A 7-membered, fully conjugated, planar ring with 6 π-electrons. Follows (4n + 2) rule → Aromatic (1) and Homocyclic (4).
$ $
$ Correct$ matching:

$ $(Q) → (2), (5)
$ $(R) → (3), (4)
